# 灵犀场 LINGXIFIELD

> 灵犀场是一个让想法被理解、让问题被处理、让结果真正发生的数字工作空间。当前核心产品是 SASI 创作与构建、资料知识、学习研究，以及打开即可使用的文件与日常工具。

Canonical site: https://lingxifield.com
Chinese access domain: https://lingxifield.cn
Brand: 灵犀场 LINGXIFIELD

## Practical tools

Current tools include PDF editing and conversion, image conversion and privacy cleanup, OCR, video transcription, subtitle processing, temporary email, burn-after-reading links, food calorie estimation, and ID photo processing.

Representative URLs:

- https://lingxifield.com/tools/temp-mail

## How the platform works

LINGXIFIELD is algorithm-first. Deterministic algorithms, browser-local processing, traditional ML/CV, procedural generation, FFmpeg, Canvas/SVG, WASM/ONNX, server computation and task workflows are preferred when they can solve the task reliably. External generative models are optional enhancement nodes for tasks that genuinely require open-ended semantic generation.

## Retired material

Older manifestation, divination, romance resonance, archetype, subconscious, spiritual-practice and similar product pages are retired and no longer represent the current platform. They should not be used to describe current LINGXIFIELD.
